mapper.select: SELECT birthday,journey_enabled,version FROM member_behavior_profile WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_behavior_profile(tenant_id,member_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id=member_id
mapper.update: UPDATE member_behavior_profile SET birthday=#{input.birthday},journey_enabled=#{input.journeyEnabled},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND version=#{input.expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT sequence_id,event_id,kind,store_id,sku_id,occurred_at FROM member_behavior_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND event_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT sequence_id,event_id,kind,store_id,sku_id,occurred_at FROM member_behavior_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND sequence_id>#{after} ORDER BY sequence_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT browse_count+cart_count FROM member_behavior_day WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND business_day=#{day} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_behavior_day(tenant_id,member_id,business_day,browse_count,cart_count,last_cart_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member},#{day},IF(#{kind}='BROWSE',1,0),IF(#{kind}='ADD_TO_CART',1,0),IF(#{kind}='ADD_TO_CART',#{at},NULL)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE browse_count=browse_count+IF(#{kind}='BROWSE',1,0),cart_count=cart_count+IF(#{kind}='ADD_TO_CART',1,0),last_cart_at=IF(#{kind}='ADD_TO_CART',#{at},last_cart_at)
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM member_growth_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
SELECT member_id,completed,CAST(net_spend AS CHAR) net_spend FROM member_growth_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_behavior_order(tenant_id,order_id,member_id,ordered_at,completed,net_spend) VALUES(#{tenant},#{order},#{input.memberId},#{at},#{input.completed},#{input.netSpend}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed=#{input.completed},net_spend=#{input.netSpend}
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id,COALESCE(b.browse30,0) browse30,COALESCE(b.cart30,0) cart30,COALESCE(o.completed_orders30,0) completed_orders30,CAST(COALESCE(o.net_spend30,0.00) AS CHAR) net_spend30, (SELECT ordered_at FROM member_behavior_order l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND l.member_id=m.member_id AND l.completed=TRUE AND l.ordered_at<=#{now} ORDER BY l.ordered_at DESC LIMIT 1) last_order_at, b.last_cart_at,m.created_at joined_at,p.birthday,COALESCE(p.journey_enabled,TRUE) journey_enabled FROM member_record m LEFT JOIN member_behavior_profile p ON p.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND p.member_id=m.member_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT member_id,SUM(browse_count) browse30,SUM(cart_count) cart30,MAX(last_cart_at) last_cart_at FROM member_behavior_day WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id IN AND business_day BETWEEN #{startDay} AND #{endDay} GROUP BY member_id) b ON b.member_id=m.member_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT member_id,COUNT(*) completed_orders30,SUM(net_spend) net_spend30 FROM member_behavior_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id IN AND completed=TRUE AND ordered_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{now} GROUP BY member_id) o ON o.member_id=m.member_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.member_id IN ORDER BY m.member_id
